items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: She played piano with us, that's right, she was playing piano.

ctx.x: There was a guy, an old man Cooper, but he's dead, and there was Charlie Lawson. Oh, yeah, trombone. That's right, Cooper and Charlie Lawson.
Did Marge Crep, that's Zutty's single, that's right, did she play piano?
She played piano with us, that's right, she was playing piano.
